narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no long pauses.

priya.instruct: Bubbly, breathless young woman bursting in with exciting news, fast and loud.

ella.instruct: Calm, slow, immovable young woman, low and stubborn, completely final.

zoe.instruct: Pleading, cheerful friend trying to coax someone, quick and a little whiny.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You just stole a fry from a Taurus.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That was the biggest mistake of your life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her name is Ella. Calm, loyal, and very comfortable.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her couch is velvet. Her blanket weighs more than you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She's worn the same perfume for twelve years.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tonight is girls' night, and Ella planned it perfectly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her favorite table, her favorite pasta, her favorite chair.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then Priya bursts through the door.

lines.speaker: priya
lines.text: Change of plans, girls! New sushi place!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ella's fork stops in midair, and the room goes cold.

lines.speaker: ella
lines.text: I already pictured the pasta. I'm not leaving.

lines.speaker: zoe
lines.text: Come on, Ella, it's right around the corner!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Zoe tries to drag her chair, and falls right over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's going on inside a Taurus?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a bank vault, sealed with a padlock marked PLANS.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside, a dial labelled COMFORT is stuck on maximum.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The floor is bolted down, with a sign that says NOT MOVING.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And in the corner, a counter labelled GRUDGES.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's on thirty-one, and it never goes down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Number thirty-one is you. You took a fry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priya goes to sushi alone. Ella orders dessert.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then her cousin reaches for the bread basket.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The counter clicks to thirty-two.
